description: I am a BTech Computer Science student with an interest in technology, problem-solving, AI, and space exploration. I have basic knowledge of Python, Java, SQL, and OOP concepts, and I am continuously improving my technical skills. I am excited to collaborate, learn new things, and contribute creative ideas to innovative projects. I am looking for enthusiastic, dedicated team members with skills in coding, AI/ML, web development, data analysis, and creative problem-solving.
summary: I am interested in creating an innovative and interactive game inspired by NASA and space exploration. My goal is to design a fun, engaging, and educational gaming experience that helps players explore space, understand planets, discover space missions, and learn about the universe through challenges and creativity. I am looking for passionate teammates with skills in game development, UI/UX design, coding, animation, 3D modelling, and creative thinking. Let's combine our ideas and build an exciting space adventure!
